problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:

* Package A: volume 10 cubic feet, revenue $179
* Package B: volume 38 cubic feet, revenue $42
* Package C: volume 6 cubic feet, revenue $200
* Package D: volume 14 cubic feet, revenue $139
* Package E: volume 29 cubic feet, revenue $179
* Package F: volume 44 cubic feet, revenue $258
* Package G: volume 31 cubic feet, revenue $284
* Package H: volume 34 cubic feet, revenue $53
* Package I: volume 6 cubic feet, revenue $171
* Package J: volume 29 cubic feet, revenue $206
* Package K: volume 50 cubic feet, revenue $216
* Package L: volume 35 cubic feet, revenue $255
* Package M: volume 36 cubic feet, revenue $228
* Package N: volume 34 cubic feet, revenue $47
* Package O: volume 15 cubic feet, revenue $83
* Package P: volume 42 cubic feet, revenue $214
* Package Q: volume 33 cubic feet, revenue $170

The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 340 cubic feet. Choose the set of packages that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
